title: Crust of Rust: async/await
summary: Jon Gjengset's long live-coding Crust of Rust episode on async/await, focused on the mental model for using it rather than on Futures, Pin and Wakers internals. Topics include awaiting multiple futures, cancellation, executors and select.
why: Recommended as a deep, practical dive for learning how Rust async works.
